Refactored the API surface so callers no longer need to manually compose parsing, graph construction, and algorithm invocation. The key change is [WeightedGraphs.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/025_kruskals_mst/WeightedGraphs.java:4), which centralizes graph creation from either `List<Edge>` or legacy `int[][]` input.

I also expanded [MinimumSpanningTreeAlgorithm.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/025_kruskals_mst/MinimumSpanningTreeAlgorithm.java:3) with default overloads, so algorithms can operate on raw inputs directly without pushing that wiring into every caller. That let me simplify [KruskalMST.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/025_kruskals_mst/KruskalMST.java:3) into a thinner facade and clean up [KruskalMSTDemo.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/025_kruskals_mst/KruskalMSTDemo.java:5). As part of that, `EdgeRowParser.java` was removed because its responsibility is now absorbed into the graph factory.
